reason: It's free this term and the school assigns it, so I'll let him do the 20 minutes, but I'm not committing money until I see the end-of-term re-test. If the gaps don't close, it's just more tablet time.
objection: This is another 20 minutes on a screen every day, and with my long hours and my parents supervising, I can't be sure he stays on the practice and doesn't drift to other things on the device.
would_change_my_mind: The end-of-term re-test showing clear improvement on his gap topics in the school's own chapters, plus the teacher telling me it actually helped in class.
